parakeet: The gods of Greek mythology are guilty of doing some of the same awful things that the God of the Bible is guilty of. So then why is Greek mythology okay and and the Bible bad? Well, it's not about a book, it's about the belief. When when we read about the Greek gods raping or murdering, even if we enjoy the story, we still recognize that the activity is absolutely wrong. When we read about God raping or murdering, we separate ourselves from that idea of this being wrong and obligate ourselves to approve of such behavior. So it's not the book that's the problem, it's the belief, because the belief does create cognitive disassociation. Those are my thoughts.
